posts.zh:
dsh-webchatlike 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5799e82fdc1ebcf6b92d.html
posts.en:
dsh-webchatlike is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5799e82fdc1ebcf6b92d.html
